name: Bellows Studio Loft  Apartment
description:
Famous American artist George Bellows home with studio loft apartment, features a completely private oasis for two with private bath, kitchenette, dining and sitting areas. Walk to downtown with easy access to the freeway and public transportation. The homeowners are both artists and guests will enjoy the art that adorns the walls. There are several eateries within a 5 minute walk. And a new brewery!
Additionally, there are no security cameras in the unit.
host_about:
My husband Eric and I are both artists, sharing studio space in our house. We have 2 daughters and 3 grandchildren, all of whom live in Columbus.  I've been a yoga teacher since 1988. I have taught at Yoga on High since it's inception in 2000 and earned my certification from Yoga Alliance of ERYT 1500 at Yoga on High. I love sharing this ancient practice with all kinds of people. I have seen it have profound effects on people's lives. It is an honor and a responsibility for which I am very grateful. 
 Eric and I have lived in this historic home for over 35 years, in what we consider the best neighborhood in the city, Olde Towne. We love sharing our home with friends and now airbnb guests. We enjoy walking in the woods, gardening, biking, kayaking, reading and, of course, practicing yoga. 
We also love to travel. We've been told we are easy guests. We like to take care of ourselves and not add unduly to our hosts workload. Car camping is a favorite vacation of ours.
 I'd say our airbnb hosting style is also casual: I try to think of anything a guest might need and supply it, so they can have a relaxed stay with us. We have maps of the neighborhood and menus for the local cafes and the bakery in a notebook in The Loft. We try to help out with rides when we can. We have a table in The Loft that is perfect for working or dining. A guest set up her sewing machine up there.
My favorite quote is from Emmanuel: "Your life is not your master, it is your child." Let us host your next visit to Columbus as you create your perfect visit.

host_about:
My husband and I moved to Columbus from NJ to be with our grandchildren a few years ago.  We bought our house as a rehab and have been working on it since.  This is a new experience for us but we have enjoyed it.

We are both originally from the Midwest, my husband was born in Kansas and grew up in Illinois.  I was born and grew up in Michigan.  We lived in Colorado for 13 years before moving to NJ and have loved all the places we have lived.  

We have travelled to many parts of the world (Mexico, Israel, Philippines, Korea, Europe) and enjoyed the different cultures as well as made many new friends.  I think this is one of the reasons we love Columbus.  There are so many different cultures here as well as their cuisines which I love to try. We find Columbus offers many of the experiences of a larger city but love the smaller size.

name: Wincott Place - A Clintonville Gem
description:
Wincott Place is a single family home, in the heart of Clintonville, with easy access to 315 and 71. On-street parking outside the front door.

Perfect for a fun weekend getaway, weekday business trip, or longer stay. One night stays available. A close drive to the Short North, Grandview, Ohio State University, Downtown, Easton (in and outdoor mall) and Polaris (IKEA and indoor mall) for shopping trips.

No pets allowed due to family allergies.

Entire house and contents are pet/smoke free.
host_about:
We live in Clintonville and have three cats and two dogs.  We live and work in the community. As the hosts of Wincott Place we want our guests to feel comfortable and at home when they stay with us.  

Having stayed on friend's couches, in numerous hotel rooms, BNB's, and Airbnb the conversation has always centered on what would we do differently as a host.  From having a throw blanket for lounging on the couch, that certain kitchen tool, green space outside,  to having games available to play as a group or family. 

We try to be mindful of the earth and conservation. Our rental has general recycling available for our guests. If you are not sure if something can be recycled, leave it for us and we will make the decision for you. We also compost food. Leave us your leftovers (and scrap remnants if you like) in the refrigerator. The local composting company we work with that will even take meat and bones. 

Each of our animals has their own distinct personalities that make us smile and want to give them a hug.  This does not mean that everyone else does though. We each have several family members with pet allergies so we want there to be somewhere that is pet free, has items in it that have not been in contact with animals, like Wincott Place, to keep allergies at bay.

host_about:
Hi there!

We are Susan and Boris - a young, professional couple who are happy to host you in our home!

I (Susan) am originally from China and have been living in the US for nearly 8 years, having originally moved here for grad school and then ending up working as a digital marketer. My husband, Boris, is a startup founder who runs his own electric bike company. 

I'm a huge photography buff - many of the photos you'll see in our house are the ones done by us in our travels.

We both love to travel ourselves and try to stay at Airbnb wherever we go. Over the last few years, we've traveled together to Africa, Cuba, Iceland, Eastern and Western Europe, and Asia - as much as possible we love to incorporate travel in our lifestyle. Actually, in 2018, we've realized one of our biggest dreams - having done a 20,000 mile overland journey from US to Argentina by car. On the long-distance journey, we've stayed in many Airbnbs who have become the highlights for us.

We wanted to share our house with Airbnb guests as a way to pay back the incredibly hospitality and experiences we've encountered ourselves during our travels. We know what it's like to come to a new place for the first time and our goal is to provide you with a wonderful, cozy and unique place to stay and advice and feedback that you would expect from a friend.

We can't wait to meet you and host you!
